most_similar_reason: Candidate 7 shares the same core myth complex: sibling-spouse deities born of earth and sky, the murder and dismemberment of the husband-king by a jealous brother, the wife and her sister gathering the scattered pieces, magical revival and posthumous conception of a son who later avenges his father against the usurping brother, with the murdered king thereafter confined to the underworld.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 2 is a descriptive account of an unknowable supreme creator approached through spirit mediums, with no murdered god, no dismemberment, no avenging son, and no civilizing culture-hero episodes.
